question: The stratosphere extend above the tropopause up to:
solution:
The correct answer is **50 km**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **stratosphere** is the second major layer of Earth's atmosphere, just above the **tropopause**.
 
• It extends from about **10 km to 50 km** above the Earth's surface.
